text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so fast... Man, it sucks<n>knowing I
still don't have what it<n>takes.

text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so fast... Man, it sucks<n>knowing I
still don't have what it<n>takes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're right. I need to believe in my<n>potential!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey-hey, let's have an evaluation<n>meeting right
now! We need a plan if<n>we're going to win the next
one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm right there with you! I'll<n>definitely win
first in my next race!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's figure out what kind of training<n>regime I need
to make that happen!
